title.en: Z.AI files a conditional proposal for up to $5 billion in share and bond financing
title.zhHans: Z.AI 提交最多约 50 亿美元的有条件股份及债券融资方案

searchSummary.en: Z.AI's HKEX filing records a proposed placing of up to 21.965 million H shares and a proposed RMB20.14 billion zero-coupon convertible-bond issue, both subject to conditions.
searchSummary.zhHans: Z.AI 的港交所文件记录了最多 2,196.5 万股新 H 股的拟配售及人民币 201.4 亿元零息可换股债券的拟发行，两项交易均须满足条件。

summary.en: On September 13, Z.AI's HKEX filing recorded September 12 agreements for a placing of up to 21.965 million new H shares at HK$714 each and a proposed RMB20.14 billion zero-coupon convertible-bond issue settled in U.S. dollars. The filing gives expected gross proceeds of about HK$15.683 billion and US$3.016 billion, respectively, and says the transactions are conditional and independent. About 60% of planned net proceeds would support model research, training, inference, and computing infrastructure if the transactions close.
summary.zhHans: 9 月 13 日，Z.AI 的港交所文件记录了 9 月 12 日达成的协议：以每股 714 港元配售最多 2,196.5 万股新 H 股，并拟发行人民币 201.4 亿元、以美元结算的零息可换股债券。文件列出的预期所得款项总额分别约为 156.83 亿港元和 30.16 亿美元，并说明两项交易均附带条件且彼此独立。若交易完成，计划净所得款项约 60% 将用于模型研发、训练、推理和计算基础设施。

narrative.en: The exchange filing is the controlling source for the transaction status. It gives an expected placing completion date of September 16 and bond issue date of September 18, subject to listing, approval, and other conditions; either transaction may not proceed. TechNode and Caixin confirm the filing but some headlines use completed-fundraising language that is broader than the filing. This event therefore records a proposed capital allocation and financing signal, not cash already received or delivered model and infrastructure capacity.
narrative.zhHans: 港交所文件是交易状态的控制性来源。文件列出的预期配售完成日期为 9 月 16 日、债券发行日期为 9 月 18 日，但仍取决于上市、审批及其他条件，任何一项交易都可能不完成。TechNode 和财新确认了该文件，但部分标题使用了已完成融资的表述，范围超出文件本身。因此，本事件记录的是拟议资本配置和融资信号，不是已经到账的现金，也不是已经交付的模型或基础设施能力。

description.en: Signals a large planned capital allocation toward model R&D, training, inference, and computing infrastructure in China's listed AI-model sector.
description.zhHans: 表明中国上市 AI 模型企业计划将大量资本投入模型研发、训练、推理和计算基础设施。

description.en: Adds a public exchange-filing example of model development and compute infrastructure being funded through a combined equity and convertible-bond plan.
description.zhHans: 增加了一个公开交易所文件案例：模型开发和计算基础设施通过股权与可转债组合方案获得计划融资。

text.en: Z.AI's September 13 HKEX filing records a proposed placing of up to 21.965 million H shares at HK$714 and a proposed RMB20.14 billion zero-coupon convertible-bond issue.
text.zhHans: Z.AI 9 月 13 日的港交所文件记录了拟以每股 714 港元配售最多 2,196.5 万股 H 股，以及拟发行人民币 201.4 亿元零息可换股债券。

text.en: The filing says about 60% of planned net proceeds would fund next-generation GLM model R&D, large-scale training, production inference, and related computing infrastructure if the transactions close.
text.zhHans: 文件称，若交易完成，计划净所得款项约 60% 将用于下一代 GLM 模型研发、大规模训练、生产推理和相关计算基础设施。

text.en: The placing and bond issue are conditional and independent; expected proceeds must not be described as cash already received or as delivered model capacity.
text.zhHans: 配售和债券发行均附带条件且彼此独立；预期所得款项不能表述为已经到账的现金，也不能表述为已经交付的模型能力。

editorial.reviewNotes: L2 commerce/capability financing node. The HKEX filing controls: both transactions remain conditional and proposed; media headline shorthand is not adopted.
